title: Anderlecht vs Lyon: Decisive Clash in the Europa League League Stage
seoTitle: Anderlecht vs Lyon: Europa League 2026/27 Preview
subtitle: The opening match of the league stage brings high expectations and heavy betting
excerpt: On the afternoon of September 16, Anderlecht host Lyon at Lotto Park, marking both teams' debut in the 2026/27 Europa League league stage.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the afternoon of September 16, Anderlecht host Lyon at Lotto Park in Brussels, marking both teams' debut in the 2026/27 Europa League league stage. The matchup features a favorable history for the visitors, but the hosts present a real resistance in front of their home fans.

Anderlecht in winning form

The Belgian side arrives buoyed by five consecutive victories in the qualifying rounds, totaling nine goals scored across three home matches. In the Belgian league, Anderlecht maintain a perfect campaign in the playoffs, with wins over Hammarby, PAOK, and Kairat Almaty, and kept clean sheets in two occasions against Kortrijk and Genk.

Lyon with a favorable history

Lyon, managed by Paulo Fonseca, entered the competition following their playoff elimination in the Champions League by Fenerbahce. In Ligue 1, the club remains undefeated and holds three wins in four previous encounters with Anderlecht, the most notable being in 2009 with a 5-1 aggregate score.

Absences that influence the clash

Vítor Bruno will be without center-back Lucas Hey, who fractured his leg, while Sardella and Camara remain doubts. For Lyon, Kluivert, Abner, Maitland-Niles, and Tagliafico are doubts, while Bidstrup and Niakhaté are sidelined due to ankle and knee issues, respectively.

Confirmed lineups

Anderlecht: Coosemans; Augustinsson, Omobamidele, Leoni, and Maamar; Aasgaard, Llansana, and Le Pétrot; Ambros, Amane, and Cvetkovic. Lyon: Descamps; Kluivert, Mata, Niakhaté, and Ouédraogo; Boudache, Tessmann, and Morton; Nakamura, Nartey, and Openda.

Odds and betting

The odds reflect the uncertainty generated by the absences: Lyon win at 2.30, draw at 3.50, and Anderlecht win at 2.88. The goals market points to over 2.5 at 1.60 and both teams to score at 1.58.

With information from LANCE!, NETVASCO, SportyTrader.
